start_greeting: 👋 Hi! I'm KiwiManga — your personal manga & ranobe downloader.
start_about: Send me a title as plain text (e.g. Berserk) and I'll fetch chapters or whole volumes as handy CBZ/ZIP archives.
start_hint: Tap /help to learn everything, /language to switch language.
cmd_start: Start the bot and show intro
cmd_help: How to use, ZIP guide, packing modes
lang_prompt: 🌍 Choose your language: I auto-detect language from your messages — but a manual choice always wins.
help_flow: How to use 1. Send a manga/ranobe title as plain text. 2. Pick the right title from the buttons (I search titles and alt-titles in all languages). 3. Choose: last 10 chapters, a range, volume(s) or a single chapter. 4. I queue the job and send the archive(s) right here. Track with /queue and /status, stop with /cancel.
help_zip_how: What to do with the .ZIP / .CBZ • It's just a ZIP of page images. .cbz = .zip with a reader-friendly name — rename freely both ways. • Read in Mihon, CDisplayEx, Perfect Viewer, YACReader — or simply unzip and flip through the images. • Ranobe (novels) come as .epub — any e-reader opens them.
help_zip_why: Why ZIP? A volume is hundreds of pages. A single file beats 300 photos flooding your chat — kinder to Telegram limits, and kinder to your eyes. 😉
help_pack: Packing modes (switch in /settings) • Merged (default): the whole volume is one archive with continuously numbered pages. • Per-chapter: one archive containing N separate chapter files. Single chapters always come as one file. Telegram caps files at {mb} MB — bigger volumes are auto-split into labelled parts.
queue_empty: 📭 Your queue is empty. Send me a manga title to start!
cancel_none: Nothing to cancel — you have no active jobs.
cancel_many: You have several active jobs. Pick one to cancel:
status_none: No active jobs right now. Send me a title!
pack_per_chapter_name: Per-chapter — N files in one archive
search_none: 😕 Nothing found for {q}. Please send the full original title — mind the capital letters and every symbol of the official name.
range_prompt: Reply with a range like 10-25 (max {max} chapters):
range_invalid: I need a range like 10-25. Try again:
range_none: No chapters found in that range.
lang_fallback: ⚠️ No {want} chapters on this source — using {got} instead.
job_accepted: ✅ Accepted! Job #{id}, queue position {n}. I'll send the file(s) here when ready.
job_dup: ♻️ This exact job is already queued (#{id}).
job_limit_active: 🐢 Slow down — you already have {n} active jobs (max {max}). Wait a bit or /cancel one.
job_limit_chapters: 🐳 Whoa, that's {n} chapters — the limit is {max} per job. Split it up!
err_expired: ⌛ These buttons expired — search again, please!
err_source_down: 🔌 Source {source} is unreachable from this hosting right now. Try again later.
err_not_found: 🕳️ Gone from the source. Try searching again.
err_no_space: 💾 Not enough free disk space on the server. Try again later.
err_too_big_single: 📐 Even this single chapter exceeds the {mb} MB Telegram limit — can't deliver it, sorry.
